review.tagline: Multi-backend deep learning library running on JAX, TensorFlow and PyTorch
review.summary: Keras 3 is a high-level Python API for building and training neural networks. The backend is chosen with the KERAS_BACKEND variable or ~/.keras/keras.json. It trains on JAX, TensorFlow or PyTorch, and OpenVINO is supported for inference only. It is meant as a drop-in replacement for tf.keras and accepts tf.data pipelines and PyTorch DataLoaders as input.
review.audience: ML engineers who want one model API across JAX, TensorFlow and PyTorch
strengths: Same model code runs on JAX, TensorFlow or PyTorch by switching one environment variable
Keras models can be used inside native PyTorch Modules or JAX functions
Accepts tf.data.Dataset and PyTorch DataLoader inputs regardless of backend
Drop-in replacement for tf.keras when models are saved in the .keras format
weaknesses: Backend must be set before import and cannot be changed afterwards
OpenVINO backend only supports model.predict(), no training
Only Linux and macOS are listed as compatible; Windows needs WSL2
Custom layers or train_step() need conversion to be backend-agnostic
needs: Needs tensorflow >=2.16.1, jax >=0.4.20, or torch >=2.1.0 (one backend), openvino 2026.2.0 (inference only)
Models: JAX, TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenVINO (inference only)
